Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, Redwood can run a short, focused demo (30–45 minutes) to show latency/cost tradeoffs on your sample workflow and a quick glance at our rollout and observeability features.

Proposed slots next week (all PST):
- Tue 3/7, 10:30–11:15
- Wed 3/8, 2:00–2:45
- Thu 3/9, 9:00–9:45

If none of those work, tell me a window that does and I’ll coordinate engineers. I’ll attach a one-pager agenda so your product folks know what to expect.

Quick ask: would you like us to include a short section on dedicated vs. hosted tradeoffs for restricted-data projects?

Thanks —

naomi.feldman@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the follow-up and the clear agenda. Unfortunately, we need to release the demo window for now.

Short version: our product org just locked a launch candidate for late Q2 and engineering is fully reallocated for the next six weeks (plus a few folks are traveling for partner roadshows). That means we’re deprioritizing exploratory AI pilots until launch stabilizes.

Can we do the following?
1) Release the proposed demo times — we won’t be able to commit this month.
2) Let’s plan a 90-day check-in — I’ll re-open after the launch if capacity frees up.
3) Please keep any design notes and cost/latency examples we discussed; we’ll reach back when we can engage.

I’m looping in our product alias so they’re aware and can follow internally.

Sorry for the churn — would love to revisit when the launch is behind us.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Product Operations, Eversprint
Samantha.Lee@eversprint.com

Looping in my manager and solutions lead on the cc to align the nurture plan. We’ll drop a short playbook and a 90-day touch plan into HubSpot.
